name: symbolically integrate and simplify the definite integral with sympy
definition: compute the definite integral over the unit interval and return an exact simplified closed form involving the named constant.
failure_mode: a decimal approximation or an unsimplified alternative that differs from the reference fails simplify==0

name: systematically explore and infer the unknown maze layout
definition: use traversal/backtracking to visit every reachable cell, including through cycles and dead ends, collating wall/open boundaries from feedback until the layout is fully determined.
failure_mode: missing cells or mis-inferred walls fail the map equality
